taxonomy.definition: Notes show the lead's real location/market is not UAE (foreign country, offshore checkout, or a stated non-UAE primary market).
No owned sales page, checkout, or purchasable product was found (link-in-bio, DM-only, directory listing, or booking-call-only).
The lead's channel or funnel shows no recent activity (dormant blog/page, stale posts, outdated copyright year).
Confirmed audience size sits below the 1,500 floor on the platform checked.
The business is run by a team, partner, co-founder, or agency rather than a true solo operator (Gate 1 fail).
Gates passed but no reachable/deliverable email address could ever be found or verified (hard bounce, no public address, enrichment HOLD).
The lead already exists elsewhere in the CRM under a different row/status; this row was re-sourced by mistake and killed to avoid double-touching.
Lane assignment killed the lead — they have pivoted out of coaching or the funnel is not an active business, regardless of gate status.
Manual judgement that the lead is outside the track's ICP (market/language mismatch, business model mismatch) despite passing some gates.
Haytham personally overrode an automated pass/verdict based on external evidence (e.g. reviews, direct research) not captured by the standard gates.
Disqualification reason present in Notes but does not cleanly map to any of the above buckets.
